Actually, "生产、销售不符合食品安全标准的食品罪" is Article 144 of the Criminal Law (since amendment). Also possibly "非法经营罪"? But the facts specifically about selling industrial salt as edible, violating food safety. However the prosecution specifically says "应当以销售不符合安全标准的食品罪追究其刑事责任". So we list that. The Chinese law term: "销售不符合食品安全标准的食品罪". Use that exact phrase.

Thus answer: [罪名]销售不符合食品安全标准的食品罪<eoa>
